crossRefs.note: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

translations.web: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
translations.bsb: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!
translations.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
translations.asv: See with how large letters I write unto you with mine own hand.
